stage_fields.biological_unit: donor (one fetal donor = one biological replicate); spots/cells are observational units, not independent replicates
stage_fields.estimand: the unobserved spatial ATAC accessibility at each spot, recovered through the paired RNA-ATAC shared latent (CPU-only, no spatial ATAC data)
stage_fields.cohort_structure: semi-synthetic demo DGP: 300 paired scMultiome cells + 200 spatial spots; real target = paired scMultiome (RNA+ATAC, 40 donors) + Stereo-seq spatial RNA
stage_fields.leakage_graph: synthetic DGP: paired (fit) and spatial (project) drawn from the same generative latent Z by construction; ground-truth ATAC_true is held out for EVALUATION ONLY, never used in fitting
stage_fields.split_strategy: N/A semi-synthetic (ATAC_true used solely as evaluation oracle); real-data split = donor-level
